what: counterintuitive-mechanism probe batch (2026-10-12 directive): each probe gets one focused cached or held-out test; judged by measurement only
sample: first N rows of the fixed 2,000-row RefCOCO val sample (records_refcoco_glm2000.jsonl, seed 20261010); diagnostics only -- no shipped knob is tuned here, and any promoted signal would be re-validated on train-carved rows before training
candidate_ordering: released region-text similarity (sc) top-k; tie-breaks deterministic

probes.hypothesis: A VLM can select among numbered candidate overlays (Set-of-Mark) without producing coordinates -- turning selection into a classification.
probes.test: Top-8 SAM candidates tinted and numbered; GLM-4.1V asked for the index on 200 cached RefCOCO val rows; pick = answered index (unparsed answers fall back to the released pick).
probes.outcome: Set-of-Mark mIoU 39.13 vs released-pick 42.936 on the same rows; 2/200 answers unusable (truncated thinking or no index); parsed-only mIoU 39.525.

probes.hypothesis: Necessity testing by deletion: the referent is the candidate whose removal makes the expression unsatisfiable.
probes.test: Grey-out the top-2 candidates (one image each), ask GLM-4.1V whether the referent is still fully visible; fixed decision rule on 200 rows.

probes.hypothesis: Elimination is easier than selection: ask which candidate is definitely not the referent and remove it.
probes.test: Numbered top-4 overlay, ask GLM-4.1V for the one that is NOT the referent, drop it, keep the best remaining by released score (200 rows).

probes.hypothesis: A majority vote over several cheap spatial questions is a usable localization signal (democracy of weak signals).
probes.test: Three YES/NO questions (left half / top half / larger than a third) per expression; candidates vote by their own geometry (200 rows).

probes.hypothesis: Boolean mask arithmetic over the pool (unions/intersections) recovers IoU that single-pick selection wastes.
probes.test: Cached re-analysis on 1500 RefCOCO val rows: fixed union/intersection policies over the top-sc candidates plus the pair-oracle ceiling.
probes.outcome: single 35.043 / union-1-2 37.773 / union-1-2-3 36.914 / intersect-1-2 9.105 / pair-oracle 63.518 / released 44.024 mIoU.

probes.hypothesis: Much of the field's ordering is prompt-format engineering rather than localization capability.
probes.test: Same records, same rule, box prior queried with the noun phrase vs the full sentence (1500 cached rows); compare with the existing paraphrase-stability test (0/608 selections changed under template paraphrases).
probes.outcome: noun 53.843 vs sentence 68.321 (delta +14.478), noun-cache misses 702, sentence-cache misses 0; paraphrases changed nothing, so the format (not the wording) is the lever.

probes.hypothesis: Aggregating the MLLM spatial signal as a vote across candidates beats the per-candidate product of its own terms.
probes.test: Cached re-analysis on 1500 rows: candidates scored by the fraction of their mask inside the GLM grid's ON cells, argmax with released-score tie-break.
probes.outcome: grid-vote mIoU 11.108 vs released 44.024 on the same rows.
